title: Curios issue #202: Clicking on the Curios Button with an item in your cursor will not carry over the item.
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (NOASSERTION) does not cover issue text
text:
[issue by bconlon1]
#### Versions (Be specific, do not write "latest"):
* Curios: 1.18.1-5.0.4.2
* Forge: 39.0.9
#### Observed Behavior:
- When in the vanilla inventory, if you click on the Curios button with an item, it will not carry over, but clicking it again to go back will restore the item to your cursor.
- When in the Curios inventory, if you click on the Curios button with an item, it will deposit the item straight into your first hotbar slot.
#### Expected Behavior:
- The item in your cursor should not be misplaced when clicking on the Curios button, which is how this behaved in the 1.16 version.
#### Steps to Reproduce:
1. When in either the vanilla or Curios inventory, grab an item from within the inventory.
2. Click on the Curios button while the item is still grabbed.
3. The item will not stay grabbed, and will instead be misplaced in some way according to the details in __Observed Behavior__.

Crash Log: No crash log or relevant logged information.

[comment by bconlon1 (none)]
This doesn't seem to be properly fixed when clicking the button from the vanilla inventory with an item in your cursor, and also clicking from the accessory inventory has the chance of causing item duplication.
1. Grab an item while in the Curios inventory.
2. Click the Curios button to go into the vanilla inventory.
3. Deposit the item into the vanilla inventory.
4. Click the Curios button to go back to the Curios inventory.
5. The item will be put back into your cursor, despite also being still in the inventory. Neither of them are ghost items, the item has been duplicated.

I can make another issue report for this if necessary.
